routing_rationale: Use one operational GOES-R satellite over one uninterrupted historical interval to avoid pre-GOES-R XRS calibration changes and outcome-dependent satellite stitching. SWPC made GOES-16 primary for XRS and protons on 2019-12-09, GOES-14/15 were in storage by 2020-03-10, GOES-16 remained primary when GOES-18 became secondary on 2023-01-04, and GOES-19 did not replace GOES-16 as primary until April 2025.

required_semantics: XRS-A and XRS-B 1-minute irradiance variables identifiable from file metadata
UTC time coordinate identifiable from file metadata

proton.product: GOES-R SEISS SGPS L2 1-minute operational product
required_semantics: a documented integral-proton quantity suitable for the frozen >=10 MeV target is directly present OR a deterministic derivation from documented SGPS channels is specified and frozen before labels are generated
UTC time coordinate identifiable from file metadata

live_products.purpose: schema/routing compatibility check only; current live satellite identity does not rewrite the historical GOES-16 cohort

must_verify: official archive directory and daily file retrievability for XRS and SGPS
NetCDF global metadata and variable inventory
time coordinate, units, fill values and quality/status fields
proton >=10 MeV target semantics without heuristic relabelling
live SWPC XRS/proton JSON schemas and instrument-source routing

claim_boundary: Passing this contract establishes source-interface readiness only. It does not establish forecast skill, catalogue-event equivalence, independent evaluation, or operational readiness.
